name: Grown-up area
purpose: Manage local settings, backups and collection recovery with explicit outcomes.
on_enter: Enter gate before settings. This local accidental-access guard is not authentication or legal proof of consent. No external purchases or links exist.
Gate instruction: tap star, then circle, then square; choices appear in a shuffled stable-per-entry order, no timeout. Incorrect choice resets sequence gently. Keyboard activation works.
After gate, restore last settings tab: Play, Audio, Data. Tabs are visible without scroll; long Data contents scroll inside panel, not over scene controls.
on_exit: Return to captured01/15 context. Cancel queued file/import operations where safe; never unload an active commit mid-write.
persistence: Settings, backup import, bin/restore, reset use dedicated versioned transactions. Export is read-only and includes only local recipe/progression/settings data, not raw executable code or external media URLs.
back_rule: Back from subdialog returns its tab; Back from main settings returns captured context. Explicit return button always present.
acceptance: Export status never claims the file reached durable user storage without a browser signal.
Malformed/oversized/incompatible import cannot mutate current profile.
Deletion is recoverable in bin; permanent purge/reset requires a second explicit confirmation and backup option.
implementation_notes: FreePlay access does not grant permanent unlocks or erase previous economy. Turning it off restores earned access; already saved toys remain playable even if created using FreePlay-only tools.
Backup controls are buttons, replacing the misleading concept-art toggle. Use current file/download APIs only after user gesture.

actions.guard: Gate active; symbol catalogue fixed; no hidden time requirement
actions.command: Advance star→circle→square; wrong symbol resets step; third opens Play tab
actions.feedback: Gentle step check; no failure noise.
actions.interrupt: Back cancels to caller. Adult gate is not a credential.

actions.command: Render selected tab and reset its scroll top
actions.feedback: Focus first tab row or heading.
actions.interrupt: Pending import/reset confirmation must close before switching tabs.

actions.guard: Gate passed; no write in flight
actions.command: Persist preference; recalculate access union; keep earned data
actions.feedback: Pictorial all-tools available state; wallet hidden in child UI.
actions.interrupt: No new coins/unlocks generated by toggling.

actions.command: Persist tray density; keep all content reachable by pages in simple mode
actions.interrupt: Current recipe preserved; no date of birth requested.

actions.guard: Language text/voice bundle available locally or cached
actions.command: Persist language; fallback UK English text/visuals if voice absent
actions.feedback: Accessible labels and optional voice update.
actions.interrupt: No forced network wait; missing bundle not falsely selectable offline.

actions.command: Persist local session cue; elapsed active play schedules a gentle cue only at a safe boundary
actions.feedback: No countdown in child scene; dismissible break card.
actions.interrupt: Cue is not an automatic lockout or penalty; never interrupt pour, press or save.

actions.guard: Local profile readable; user gesture available
actions.command: Serialize allowlisted versioned JSON + checksum; create download; optionally file picker when supported
actions.state_write: Read-only; include schema/content versions and active/parked drafts.
actions.feedback: Preparing → download requested. Show saved-to-file only if API explicitly resolves a completed file write.
actions.interrupt: Download cancel/error keeps profile intact; do not interpret click as backed up.

actions.trigger: Choose JSON then review and confirm
actions.guard: File<=10MiB; JSON parses; supported schema; valid catalogue IDs; bounded arrays; no executable/HTML/external URLs
actions.command: Validate detached copy; display counts/settings summary; require confirmation; preserve old profile in rollback record; atomic replace/migrate
actions.state_write: Expected profile revision guard; retained prior snapshot.
actions.feedback: Import succeeded only after transaction completes.
actions.interrupt: Cancel or validation failure changes nothing. Interrupted commit restores original or complete new version, never mixture.

actions.command: List creations; Move to bin hides from shelf and retains recipe/thumb. Restore returns to next free slot. Permanent purge requires explicit second confirmation.
actions.state_write: Tombstone/bin records; no negative rewards or historical ledger deletion.
actions.feedback: Clear affected toy preview and Restore action.
actions.interrupt: Cancel leaves data. Deleting a gifted toy does not invalidate request history.

actions.trigger: Tap reset then explicit second confirm
actions.guard: Gate passed; no save/import transaction; backup option offered
actions.command: Capture rollback snapshot; clear local player progress/settings as explicitly chosen; preserve installed asset cache
actions.state_write: One reset transaction with profile revision guard.
actions.feedback: Return to Welcome only after commit; adult can restore exported data.
actions.interrupt: Cancel leaves everything; transaction abort retains prior valid profile.

actions.command: Close subdialog or return to original caller; restore focus
actions.interrupt: During commit, show busy state and keep view until terminal outcome.
